Tē 74 tô.—Âu-thâu ê chêng-bīn: 1, khoân-chōng-nńg-kut; 2, kah-chōng-nńg-kut ê hā-kak; 3, khoân-chōng-kah-chōng-tiong ê jīm-tài; 4, kah-chōng-nńg-kut ê thâu-chêng-gū; 5, kah-chōng-nńg-kut-khiah; 6, kah-chōng-chih-kut-tiong ê jīm-tài; 8, chit lia̍p nńg-kut; 9, chih-kut; 10, hōe-iàm.
Tī khoân-chōng-nńg-kut ê ē-bīn ū khì-kńg ê thâu nñg ê lûn, thâu-chêng só͘ ōe khòaⁿ ê pe̍h-pe̍h sī nńg-kut (Cunningham).
